deep_dive.title: PhysibleMDM: Enforcing Inference-Time Physical Feasibility Constraints on Motion Diffusion Models via Noise Optimization
deep_dive.abstract: Motion Diffusion Models (MDMs) can generate diverse and visually appealing human motion; yet, the resulting trajectories frequently violate physical constraints, limiting their downstream use in simulation and control. We present PhysibleMDM, a framework that promotes physical feasibility of MDM output by optimizing at inference time the diffusion noise without retraining the generative model. We introduce a set of surrogate feasibility constraints that can be evaluated without full trajectory simulation. These constraints combine kinematic checks (e.g., ground penetration, slip, and self-collision) with dynamic feasibility tests computed via an inverse-dynamics inner loop formulated as a cone program. We solve the resulting black-box noise optimization problem using the Separable Covariance Matrix Adaptation Evolution Strategy (Sep-CMA-ES), thereby avoiding reliance on computationally expensive and discontinuous gradients. An autoregressive scheme then chains optimized segments to synthesize long motion sequences. Across 100 motion styles on an SMPL humanoid, PhysibleMDM reduces mean ground penetration, self-collision penetration, and ground slip by 75%, 92%, and 74%, respectively, relative to unoptimized diffusion output. Across 11 sequences for a custom bipedal robot, it achieves median reductions of 89.5% in per-sequence mean acceleration-reconstruction error and 79.5% in the mean inverse-dynamics residual.

deep_dive.llm_tldr_cn: 人体运动扩散模型虽能生成多样动作，但输出常违反地面穿透、滑步和自碰撞等物理约束，限制其在仿真与控制中的应用。PhysibleMDM提出在推理阶段优化扩散噪声，并设计无需完整轨迹仿真的代理约束，结合运动学检查与逆动力学锥规划。该方法无需重训练即可提升生成运动的物理可行性，为运动扩散模型的实际部署提供约束保障。

quick_skim.title: Minimax-Optimal Predictive Flow Matching under Distribution Drift
quick_skim.abstract: Flow matching learns a generative velocity field by regression, but under distribution drift a field must be deployed before the current data arrive. We study this predictive problem for a fixed, possibly nonconvex, neural class, with dynamic regret against the best represented field of each round. We propose DyProd-FM, which refits flow matching on dyadic historical prefixes and selects among the fits with a sleeping Prod master. Without knowing any drift budget, it attains regret $\widetilde{O}(\min\{N_ω+1,1+\sqrt{TΩ}\})$ in the relative velocity risk variation $Ω$ and $\widetilde{O}(\min\{N_μ+1,1+T^{1/3}V_μ^{2/3}\})$ in the target-law variation $V_μ=\sum_t W_2(μ_{t+1},μ_t)$, up to approximation and fitting costs. Matching lower bounds for fixed classes show that both rates are optimal in $T$ and in the budgets up to logarithmic factors. Prior optimal dynamic-regret guarantees rely on a convex decision set with strongly convex or exp-concave losses, whereas our class may be nonconvex and no curvature in its parameters is assumed. The target-law rate rests on a second-order link between the two variations, which the base noise of flow matching provides.

quick_skim.title: Dancing Diffusion: Learning Continuous Programs for Image Generation and Editing
quick_skim.abstract: Diffusion models generate samples through a multi-step denoising trajectory, yet condition every step on the same instruction, so the trajectory cannot be addressed at the level of individual operations. We introduce Dancing Diffusion, which assigns each span of timesteps a dedicated continuous condition block and thereby turns conditioning into a latent program. A compiler maps text features into this program, and a fixed pretrained generator executes its blocks over successive sampling intervals. The trajectory can then dance, keeping its executed history while its continuation is redirected. A shared prefix is executed once and reused, and a later operation is rewritten while content fixed by earlier operations is preserved. The compiler is trained through the images it produces, with visual feedback on both the requested change and the retained content. On SANA, reusing an executed prefix preserves markedly more of the scene than regenerating from noise at a similar strength of edit, learned conditions preserve more background than native prompt switching from the same saved state, and the learned program improves generation quality over native SANA. Later branches weaken the edit, which leaves semantic control over individual operations limited. By converting a single-instruction trajectory into a program of addressable operations, Dancing Diffusion lays a foundation for structured intermediate computation in diffusion models.
quick_skim.llm_evidence_en: diffusion models for image generation with programmable conditioning

quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 扩散模型通过多步去噪生成样本，但每一步都依赖同一指令，无法在单个操作层面控制生成轨迹。本文提出Dancing Diffusion，为每个时间步区间分配独立的连续条件块，把条件转化为可由编译器映射、由固定预训练生成器执行的潜在程序。由此轨迹可在保留已执行历史的同时被改写后续内容，并复用共享前缀，实现图像生成与编辑的灵活控制。

quick_skim.title: When One Step Is Enough: An Empirical Study of Euler Integration in Flow-Matching Policies
quick_skim.abstract: Flow matching is now the dominant approach for vision-language action (VLA) robot policies, thanks to its expressiveness and simple training objective. However, inference for standard flow matching requires iteratively solving an ODE, limiting the control frequency at deployment. While several works have proposed novel methods to allow for single-shot action generation, we ask whether such additional objectives are actually necessary. We find that across six flow matching VLAs, one-step action generation largely matches multi-step sampling at scale: multi-step integration confers little to no consistent advantage at inference. We empirically find that this holds as long as models are sufficiently trained and have enough capacity. Practically, the implication is that for large VLAs, the single-step policy comes essentially for free from the multi-step model, enabling low-latency deployment without retraining, distillation, or auxiliary objectives.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 流匹配已成为视觉-语言-动作机器人策略的主流方法，但推理时需迭代求解常微分方程，限制了部署时的控制频率。本文对六个流匹配VLA策略开展实证研究，考察单步动作生成能否替代多步采样。结果表明，只要模型训练充分且容量足够，单步生成在规模上基本可媲美多步采样，多步积分在推理阶段几乎没有稳定优势，这为简化部署推理提供了依据。
